shortDescription: Membership search and onboarding home screen.
fullDescription: Home view for membership registration workflows. It renders a branded utility header, two primary entry tiles for starting a new membership or resuming a pending process, and a centered lookup form for finding existing member profiles by name, phone, email, or membership ID.

Composable membership landing component that assembles the branded top bar, large action tiles, and centered membership search section. It includes reusable tile styling for alternate workflow entry points and uses shared input and button primitives so related membership screens can reuse the same visual shell.
